The '''''Carnifex''''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] during the [[Rebellion era]].

==History==
At some point in [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] reported that a cargo ship containing a shipment of [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] went missing, but [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] censors quashed the story. Later HNN reported that the ship had been recovered by the ''Carnifex'', but [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] spies reported that the ''Carnifex'' was still looking for the ship. In reality the story was all a plan by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Veritts]], commander of the ''Carnifex'', to lure Rebels close to an Imperial cargo ship, the [[Lifeline (cargo ship)|''Lifeline'']], then unleash its secret weapon, a battery of [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well projectors]]. While the Rebels struggled to escape, the ''Carnifex'' and its escort ships swept in to disable the Rebel ships, capture them, and interrogate the prisoners.
